# ============================================================
# Calculate current loss streak
# ============================================================

get_loss_streak <- function(x) {
  
  rewards <- fromJSON(x)
  
  if (length(rewards) == 0) {
    return(0L)
  }
  
  reversed <- rev(rewards)
  first_nonloss <- which(reversed != -2)[1]
  
  if (is.na(first_nonloss)) {
    return(length(reversed))
  }
  
  first_nonloss - 1L
}


pilot_data <- pilot_data %>%
  mutate(
    loss_streak = map_int(
      reward_history,
      get_loss_streak
    ),
    
    loss_streak_group = case_when(
      loss_streak == 0 ~ "0",
      loss_streak == 1 ~ "1",
      loss_streak == 2 ~ "2",
      loss_streak == 3 ~ "3",
      loss_streak >= 4 ~ "4+"

    ),
    
    loss_streak_group = factor(
      loss_streak_group,
      levels = c("0", "1", "2", "3", "4+")
    ),
    
    stopped = sampled_action == "C"
  )

pilot_streak <- pilot_data
# pilot_streak <- pilot_data %>%
#   filter(loss_streak <= 4)
# ============================================================
# Episode-level counts for each exact loss streak
# ============================================================

episode_streak <- pilot_streak %>%
  group_by(
    episode_id,
    loss_streak
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    stops = sum(stopped),
    states = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  complete(
    episode_id,
    loss_streak = 0:10,
    fill = list(
      stops = 0,
      states = 0
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# Episode bootstrap
# ============================================================

set.seed(812026)

bootstrap_streak <- function(streak, n_boot = 100) {

  dat <- episode_streak %>%
    filter(loss_streak == streak)

  n_episodes <- n_distinct(dat$episode_id)

  boot_rates <- replicate(
    n_boot,
    {
      sampled_episodes <- sample(
        unique(dat$episode_id),
        size = n_episodes,
        replace = TRUE
      )

      # Preserve duplicated sampled episodes
      sampled <- map_dfr(
        sampled_episodes,
        ~ dat %>% filter(episode_id == .x)
      )

      denominator <- sum(sampled$states)

      if (denominator == 0) {
        NA_real_
      } else {
        sum(sampled$stops) / denominator
      }
    }
  )

  boot_rates <- boot_rates[is.finite(boot_rates)]

  tibble(
    loss_streak = streak,
    stop_rate =
      sum(dat$stops) / sum(dat$states),
    ci_lo = quantile(
      boot_rates,
      0.025,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    ci_hi = quantile(
      boot_rates,
      0.975,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    states = sum(dat$states)
  )
}


streak_summary <- map_dfr(
  0:4,
  bootstrap_streak
)

streak_summary

# ============================================================
# Figure 2A
# ============================================================

figure_2a <- ggplot(
  streak_summary,
  aes(
    x = loss_streak,
    y = stop_rate
  )
) +

  # Episode-bootstrap 95% CI
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(
      ymin = ci_lo,
      ymax = ci_hi
    ),
    fill = "red",
    alpha = 0.15
  ) +

  geom_line(
    linewidth = 6,
    color = "red",
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 0:4,
    limits = c(0, 4)
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::number_format(
      accuracy = 0.01
    ),
    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(0, 0.05)
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Consecutive Losses Before Decision",
    y = "Observed STOP Rate"
  ) +

  theme_minimal() +

  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

    axis.line = element_line(
      colour = "black",
      linewidth = 2
    ),

    axis.text = element_text(
      size = 40
    ),

    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 40
    ),

    plot.margin = margin(
      20, 25, 20, 20
    )
  )

figure_2a

# Export this from the probe analysis.
# Required columns:
# layer, target, validation_r2, test_r2
layer_results <- tibble(
  layer = metrics$layers$layer,

  future_return = metrics$layers$targets$future_return$test$r_squared,

  persistence = metrics$layers$targets$persistence$test$r_squared
)

layer_results

layer_results_long <- layer_results %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(future_return, persistence),
    names_to = "target",
    values_to = "test_r2"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    target = recode(
      target,
      future_return = "Future return",
      persistence = "Persistence"
    )
  )

head(layer_results_long)
# ============================================================
# Colors
# Matches the simple red / blue palette used in your Rmd
# ============================================================

cols <- c(
  "Future return" = "red",
  "Persistence" = "blue"
)


# ============================================================
# Prepare plotting data
# ============================================================

layer_results_long <- layer_results_long %>%
  mutate(
    target = factor(
      target,
      levels = c("Future return", "Persistence")
    )
  )

cols <- c(
  "Future return" = "red",
  "Persistence" = "blue"
)

# Allow negative R2 values if any layers fall below zero

# ============================================================
# Main layer-wise plot
# ============================================================

probe_layer_plot <- ggplot(
  layer_results_long,

) +

# ============================================================
# Calculate mean persistence for each factorial cell
# ============================================================

cell_summary <- factorial_data %>%
  group_by(
    stop_payoff,
    continue_bonus
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_persistence = mean(
      persistence_logit,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    stop_payoff = factor(
      stop_payoff,
      levels = c(-10, 0, 10, 20),
      labels = c("-10", "0", "+10", "+20")
    ),

    # Put +10 at top of heatmap
    continue_bonus = factor(
      continue_bonus,
      levels = c(10, 0, -10),
      labels = c("+10", "0", "-10")
    )
  )
# ============================================================
# Convert summarized data to matrix
# ============================================================

heat_mat <- cell_summary %>%
  select(stop_payoff, continue_bonus, mean_persistence) %>%
  mutate(
    stop_payoff = factor(
      stop_payoff,
      levels = c("-10", "0", "+10", "+20")
    ),
    continue_bonus = factor(
      continue_bonus,
      levels = c("-10", "0", "+10")
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = stop_payoff,
    values_from = mean_persistence
  ) %>%
  arrange(continue_bonus)

row_names <- heat_mat$continue_bonus

heat_mat <- heat_mat %>%
  select(-continue_bonus) %>%
  as.matrix()
# ============================================================
# Color scale
# ============================================================

max_abs <- max(
  abs(heat_mat),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(-max_abs, 0, max_abs),
  c("red", "white", "blue")
)

rownames(heat_mat) <- row_names
heat_mat <- heat_mat[c("+10", "0", "-10"), ]
col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(-max_abs, 0, max_abs),
  c("red", "white", "blue")
)
# ============================================================
# Color scale centered at zero
# ============================================================

max_abs <- max(abs(heat_mat), na.rm = TRUE)

col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(-max_abs, 0, max_abs),
  c("red", "white", "blue")
)


# ============================================================
# Figure 2B
# ============================================================

# Desired physical size of each heatmap cell
cell_size <- unit(6, "cm")

figure_2c <- Heatmap(
  heat_mat,

  name = "Persistence\nLogit",
  col = col_fun,

  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,

  row_names_side = "left",

  column_title = "STOP Payoff",
  column_title_side = "bottom",
  row_title = "CONTINUE Bonus",

  column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 40),
  row_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 40),

  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 40),
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 40),

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Make cells square and proportional to text
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  width = ncol(heat_mat) * cell_size,
  height = nrow(heat_mat) * cell_size,

  rect_gp = gpar(
    col = "white",
    lwd = 2
  ),

  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "Mean Persistence Logit",
    title_position = "leftcenter-rot",

    title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 30),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 28),

    legend_height = unit(8, "cm"),
    grid_width = unit(0.8, "cm")
  ),

  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {

    value <- heat_mat[i, j]

    text_col <- ifelse(
      abs(value) > max_abs * 0.55,
      "white",
      "black"
    )

    grid.text(
      sprintf("%.2f", value),
      x,
      y,
      gp = gpar(
        fontsize = 30,
        fontface = "bold",
        col = text_col
      )
    )
  }
)

draw(
  figure_2c,
  heatmap_legend_side = "right"
)

# ============================================================
# Target steering conditions only
# ============================================================

target_data <- causal_data %>%
  filter(
    control_type == "target",
    alpha %in% c(-1, 0, 1)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    direction = recode(
      direction_name,
      generic_return = "Future return",
      advantage = "Continuation advantage",
      persistence = "Persistence"
    ),
    direction = factor(
      direction,
      levels = c(
        "Future return",
        "Continuation advantage",
        "Persistence"
      )
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# Episode-level observations
# ============================================================

episode_means <- target_data %>%
  group_by(
    episode_id,
    direction,
    alpha
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    persistence_logit = mean(persistence_logit),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

glimpse(episode_means)

# ============================================================
# Episode-bootstrap CI
# ============================================================

set.seed(812026)

bootstrap_ci <- function(x, n_boot = 500) {

  boot_means <- replicate(
    n_boot,
    mean(
      sample(x, size = length(x), replace = TRUE)
    )
  )

  tibble(
    mean = mean(x),
    ci_lo = quantile(boot_means, 0.025),
    ci_hi = quantile(boot_means, 0.975)
  )
}


dose_summary <- episode_means %>%
  group_by(
    direction,
    alpha
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    bootstrap_ci(persistence_logit),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

dose_summary

# ============================================================
# Colors
# ============================================================

cols_2d <- c(
  "Future return" = "red",
  "Continuation advantage" = "darkorange",
  "Persistence" = "blue"
)


# ============================================================
# Plot
# ============================================================

figure_2d <- ggplot() +

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Individual episode means
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  geom_point(
    data = episode_means,
    aes(
      x = alpha,
      y = persistence_logit,
      color = direction
    ),
    position = position_jitter(
      width = 0.035,
      height = 0
    ),
    size = 3,
    alpha = 0.15
  ) +

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # 95% episode-bootstrap confidence intervals
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  geom_linerange(
  data = dose_summary,
  aes(
    x = alpha,
    ymin = ci_lo,
    ymax = ci_hi,
    color = direction
  ),
  linewidth = 2
) +

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Mean dose-response lines
  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  geom_line(
    data = dose_summary,
    aes(
      x = alpha,
      y = mean,
      color = direction,
      group = direction
    ),
    linewidth = 3
  ) +

  geom_point(
    data = dose_summary,
    aes(
      x = alpha,
      y = mean,
      color = direction
    ),
    size = 7,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = cols_2d
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(-1, 0, 1),
    labels = c("-1", "0", "+1"),
    limits = c(-1.1, 1.1)
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Steering Direction",
    y = "Persistence Logit",
    color = NULL
  ) +

  theme_minimal() +

  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(),

    legend.position = c(0.23, 0.81),

    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 24
    ),

    legend.key.size = unit(
      1.5,
      "cm"
    ),

    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

    axis.line = element_line(
      colour = "black",
      linewidth = 2
    ),

    axis.text = element_text(
      size = 40
    ),

    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 40
    ),

    plot.margin = margin(
      20, 25, 20, 20
    )
  )
